integrity: All-prime statement analytically proved using zero-sum atomic decomposition, quadratic Gauss sums and Legendre autocorrelation; twenty-one primes computed only as corroboration. No independent validation claimed.
limitations: Finite real prime cycles with p congruent to 1 mod 4, unit edges and the nonzero quadratic-residue mask; nonlinear result gives a lower witness and an order-tight bound, not exact nonlinear norm. Historical uniqueness against unindexed cyclotomic literature is not established.
title: Exact Paley spectral projection norm in cyclic total variation and nonlinear shrinkage instability
